parent.description: The version this one was made from (a fork's parent is the version it branched off).

run_id.description: ADDITIVE (DES-CHAT-ARTIFACTS-001 §6.2): the run that made this version, or null when no run did (a hand edit, a fork, a person's re-theme). The manifest entry records the same value; an entry from before this field has no run_id key (unknown).

project_id.description: ADDITIVE (DES-PROJECT-001 §2.3): the crew project this doc is bound to. Absent for unbound docs; consumers that don't know the field ignore it.
